title: ILP · Non-face-to-face · Video call sale
focus: Verify the non-face-to-face process was sound: identity checked on video, documents shown on screen, client signed on their own device, no Singpass/OTP sharing. Also check whether a financial health review was done remotely before the ILP was recommended.
roleplay_tips: Say it was mostly over WhatsApp messages
Say you read an OTP out to the agent so he could 'help submit'
Say the Benefit Illustration was only emailed afterwards
